title: Learn-then-escalate: From first shard harvest to worker automation and 91-shard climax

clips.why: Quick, clear first action showing crystal mining without slow tutorial text.
Stocks the market bin as customers line up to buy shards.
Collects the first 46 gold bars earned from sales.
Hires the first worker on the 10-gold pad and reveals higher-tier upgrades.
Escalates to gathering a massive towering stack of 91 glowing shards.
Hauls the 91-shard stack to the market bin for a huge drop-off.
Collects an 89-gold payout to fund the next wave of upgrades.
